_note: ad-draft output, FACELESS-WORLD vehicle. Same BeatsFile contract as beats.template.json (domain/beats.ts); this template differs ONLY in the vehicle's slot declarations and the visual authoring rule. NO character, NO lock (omit both; never inject a {LOCK}). treatment default = photoreal. Voice + music still required (VO-first timing unchanged). format/length semantics unchanged.
_authoring_rule: THE FACELESS-WORLD RULE (why this vehicle exists): every visual is DERIVED FROM THE SCRIPT BUT REUSABLE. Recipe per beat: take the VO line, keep its NOUNS (the world icons: Bible, study table, coffee, phone, warm light, church room...) and its EMOTION (uncertainty, relief, warmth...), DROP its narrative action (never enact the line; no 'she falters when asked'). People are allowed but FACELESS ONLY: hands, silhouettes, from-behind, over-the-shoulder, out-of-focus figures; never an identifiable face. THE REUSE TEST before accepting a prompt: imagine the clip with the VO muted; if you can tell which ad it came from, it is too coupled, generalize it; it should sit believably under ~5 different scripts' same-role lines. EXCEPTION: a beat whose copy names or demos the app MUST show the app (prefer the real app-bridge clip; it is already faceless + reusable). Tag every asset for the library: role-emotion (e.g. symptom/uncertainty) + icons (e.g. bible, hands, table); tags go to productions/library/manifest.json at produce.

coordinate.style: Photorealistic cinematic footage, warm natural light, shallow depth of field.

beats.i2v: Global: preserve the look from the start image. Subtle motion: <one gentle ambient movement (light shifts, page turns, steam rises, hands move)>. No faces revealed. No redesign.

_variants_note: Same shared variant shape as beats.template.json. NOTE what iteration means in THIS vehicle: with no character, there is no cast cascade; visuals swap freely per beat (each is a self-contained library asset), so per-beat visual swaps are the cheap default and line/voice/music swaps stay cheap as always.
_library_note: REUSE-FIRST (v1, manual): before writing a beat's t2i, check productions/library/manifest.json for an asset whose role_emotion + icons fit the line; on a hit, point the beat at that clip (the app-bridge pool-pointing mechanism) instead of generating. On a miss, write the prompt; the produced asset joins the library with its tags.
